questions.question: What is the famous declaration in Deuteronomy 6:4?
options: The Golden Rule: "Do to others as you would have them do to you"
The first commandment: "You shall have no other gods before me"
The blessing: "The LORD bless you and keep you"

questions.question: How were the Israelites to teach God's commands to their children?
options: Only through the priests and the Levites
Diligently, talking of them at home and on the way
Once each year at the great festival gathering
By having them copy out the whole law by hand
questions.answer: Diligently, talking of them at home and on the way

questions.question: "You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, soul, and might."
"Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is _____."
"You shall love the LORD your God with all your _____," and soul and might.
